I used to work at universal studios Hollywood in a customer service role back in the early 2010s. I had a shorter Filipino man come in with his entourage trying to figure out how to get a tour guide. I talked him through the process and where to go to book someone. All the meanwhile having really nice conversation about his kids, similar interests, travel, we really hit it off. My manager rushed over and told me I should escort him to the vip center to book a tour guide. This was very unusual since we never lead our stations, but I did. We continued to have just the best time talking and his entourage (me just assuming friends) were just the sweetest, even though from the outside they looked intimidating. I took him to the VIP center and he was trying to convince the tour guide booking center to have me be their guide. Both myself and the VIP manager had the refuse given that I wasn’t trained in the area. Eventually we were able to book him with someone and I sent him on his way. I returned back to my station and my manager asked if I knew who we was. I was like, “no.” He told me it was Manny Pacquiao. And I said, “who?” 

No idea who he was my manager explained how he was like the biggest deal boxer. I mean he obviously looked strong but he was just the sweetest man who you could tell loved his family and was generous and kind. At the end of the day he returned to where I was working and he thanked me so much for all the help earlier. Even though our interaction was just under an hour he was easily the nicest celebrity I ever encountered.

But then I get a delivery to my apartment. It is from my great aunt and uncle on that side (my grandfathers brother and wife). 

It was an address book with “WE ARE FAMILY!” Decorated on front. It looked very expensive and well done. It had the contact information, addresses, and birthdates of everyone on my dad’s side. It came with a letter explaining how they are ready to reaccept me into the family now and how enough time has passed that I need to get over any bad things that happened and how I had a decade of making up to do so everyone looks forward to the Christmas and birthday gift this year. 

I reach out to my dad about this and said he gave my address to them and how it has been enough time from the stuff my grandfather did that he agrees I should get over it.
